svg.title: Yomira and the Suwayomi server/client architecture
svg.desc: Suwayomi-Server runs source extensions and keeps the library, progress, categories, trackers, and server downloads. Yomira on Android, Suwayomi WebUI in a browser, and Tachidesk-Sorayomi connect through the server API. Yomira can also save completed phone downloads and synchronize offline reading progress after reconnecting.

g.text: You host it. It runs your sources.
Several clients can use the same server.
Clients request pages and update progress.
Read and manage your server in a browser
Another way to access your Suwayomi library
Offline in Yomira: completed phone downloads
Server downloads stay on the server. Phone downloads stay on your phone.
